corrected_content.problem: Calculate the volume of the parallelepiped spanned by $\mathbf{a}=⟨-3,0,-2⟩$, $\mathbf{b}=⟨1,5,-3⟩$, and $\mathbf{c}=⟨2,-1,4⟩$.
corrected_content.worked_solution: The volume is the absolute value of the scalar triple product. Here $b\times c=\langle17,-10,-11\rangle$, so $$V=|a\cdot(b\times c)|=|-3(17)-2(-11)|=|-29|=29.$$
